notes: Turn an existing document into a reusable template. Prepare it in a separate template conversation, review the proposed Word document and save it to your library, while keeping the original intact. A cleaner, calmer workspace. Buttons, cards, menus and icons now share one consistent look. The app also reads better on small screens and in high-contrast mode. Stronger security. We updated the components doc.haus is built on, including the ones that handle the documents you upload, to close known security issues.
